title: Message Passing with make-account
description: make-account returns a dispatcher that selects withdraw, deposit, or balance operations based on a message symbol, encapsulating state in a closure.

steps.description: Reveal make-account: defines withdraw, deposit, and returns a message dispatcher.
Focus on withdraw: checks balance, updates with set!, returns new balance or error.
Focus on deposit: adds to balance and returns new balance.

steps.question: What does ((acc 'deposit) 50) return when acc starts at 100?

steps.description: Reveal usage: create account, deposit 50, withdraw 30, check balance.
Focus on dispatcher: cond on message symbol returns withdraw, deposit, or balance.
